# Reclaim

> Reclaim is a Mac disk space analyzer and cleaner. It shows what's filling up your Mac and helps you free up space safely, without guessing. It is a one-time purchase, pay what you want from $5 USD (suggested $8), with all future updates included and no subscription.

Last updated: 2026-11-14

## Product

- Website: https://reclaimdiskspace.com/
- Category: Mac disk space analyzer and cleaner (macOS utility)
- Current version: 1.0
- Who it is for: Mac owners who see "Your disk is almost full" and can't tell what is taking up space on their Mac
- What it is not: an antivirus or a "speed up your Mac" suite. It only deals with disk space

## Features

- Disk usage map: browse your drive by folder and see exactly where the space went
- Safe cleanup: finds caches, logs, old installers and leftovers from deleted apps, sorted by how safe they are to remove
- Large files: lists the biggest files on your Mac so you can decide what to keep
- Unused apps: shows apps you haven't opened in a long time, with their size, and removes them cleanly
- iCloud offload: moves files to iCloud Drive or removes local copies of files already stored there
- "What is this?": explains what an unfamiliar file or folder is for, using Apple Intelligence entirely on your Mac

## Price

- One-time purchase. Pay what you want, starting at $5 USD (suggested $8)
- Includes all future updates. There is no subscription
- There is no free trial. There is a 30-day refund, in full, no questions asked
- Payment, sales tax and receipts are handled by Stripe

## Requirements

- macOS 15 Sequoia or later
- The "What is this?" explanations need macOS 26 or later on a Mac that supports Apple Intelligence
- Signed and notarized by Apple

## Safety and privacy

- Nothing is deleted until you review it and confirm
- By default, items go to the Trash so you can restore them. Permanent deletion only happens when you choose it
- Reclaim runs entirely on your Mac. It doesn't collect analytics, track you, or send your files or file names anywhere
- File explanations use Apple Intelligence on your Mac, not an online service
